concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-oxxo]] — 2026-09-15-captured Mexican OXXO cash-voucher method overview with delayed payment confirmation, unpaid voucher expiry, MX/MXN capability matrix, and integration routes.
warnings: Voucher issuance is not paid/final status; confirmation is typically within one business day but may take longer.
The seven-day open interval applies to a voucher unpaid before its due date; do not restate it as seven days from voucher issuance.
